evaluation.overall_comment:
A solid and scientifically competent translation that successfully adapts a physics podcast script into Swedish while preserving its conversational tone and logical structure. The handling of complex quantum and optical terminology is impressive and accessible. With minor polishing to fix these lexical/contextual slips, the text would be highly professional and publication-ready for its intended audience.
